WITH total_calc AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
shares_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.articount,
    tc.total_artifacts,
    CAST(sf.articount AS FLOAT) / tc.total_artifacts as share
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  CROSS JOIN total_calc tc
  WHERE sf.articount IS NOT NULL
    AND tc.total_artifacts IS NOT NULL
    AND tc.total_artifacts > 0
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares_calc
),
final_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    sc.articount,
    sc.share,
    sc.share - ac.avg_share as diff_from_avg
  FROM shares_calc sc
  CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  articount,
  share,
  diff_from_avg
FROM final_calc
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
